# Generated by tools/port_missing.py from the Vic2 DoD decision files the content audit found missing.

dod_tp_pearl_river = {
	is_shown = {
		country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
		NOT = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_GUANGDONG }
		NOT = { has_variable = dod_tp_pearl_river }
	}
	possible = {
		is_at_war = no
		s:STATE_GUANGDONG = { any_scope_state = { owner = { NOT = { country_rank >= rank_value:great_power } NOT = { this = root } } } }
	}
	when_taken = {
		set_variable = dod_tp_pearl_river
		s:STATE_GUANGDONG = { random_scope_state = { limit = { owner = { NOT = { country_rank >= rank_value:great_power } NOT = { this = root } } } save_scope_as = dod_tp_target } }
		create_diplomatic_play = { target_state = scope:dod_tp_target type = dp_take_treaty_port }
	}
	ai_chance = { value = 20 }
}
